Production Glossary · 06/50 · planning

Storyboard

Definition

Storyboard is a sequence of illustrated frames used to previsualize composition, action, transitions and camera intent. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align planning decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • Creative treatment
  • Animatic
